predecessors.name: Kingdom of Kotte
predecessors.text: Raigama Bandara's control 'roughly over present day Kalutara District' (Mayadunne of Sitawaka page)

successors.name: Kingdom of Sitawaka
successors.text: Raigama: 'roughly over present day Kalutara District & Southern Province except the coastline'

ledger.x: 1521: the Principality of Raigama is carved out of Kotte.
1521: Kalutara passes from Kotte to Raigama in the Vijayaba Kollaya.
1521: the Southern Province interior is Raigama's.
1538: the rest of Raigama goes with it.

wars.name: Vijayaba Kollaya
wars.outcome: The three sons of Vijayabahu VII killed their father and divided Kotte into Kotte, Sitawaka and the Principality of Raigama.

certainty.note: The only territorial statement is 'roughly' Kalutara District and the Southern Province without the coastline; no boundary is described.
